title: Saudi Arabia executes 2 Bangladeshis over ‘indecent acts’ in a Mecca mosque
text:
Saudi Arabia executes 2 Bangladeshis over ‘indecent acts’ in a Mecca mosque | South China Morning Post Middle East - Middle East Saudi Arabia executes 2 Bangladeshis over ‘indecent acts’ in a Mecca mosque Advertisement Middle East World Middle East Saudi Arabia executes 2 Bangladeshis over ‘indecent acts’ in a Mecca mosque 
 Dhaka says it was given no prior notice of executions as Saudis cite ‘gravity’ of violating sanctity of Islam’s holiest city
 1 -MIN READ 1 -MIN Listen Associated Press Published: 3:13am, 20 Oct 2026 Updated: 10:55am, 20 Oct 2026 Saudi Arabia has executed two Bangladeshi nationals, a man and a woman, after they were convicted of committing “indecent acts” in a mosque in the Muslim holy city of Mecca.
 Bangladesh said it was not informed before the sentences were carried out and has sought information from Saudi Arabia.
 The Saudi Interior Ministry said the Bangladeshis were executed because of “the gravity and seriousness of their actions in violating the sanctity of both time and place”.
 It did not elaborate.
